An anchor split around a block drops its empty half when the reconstructed half carries the text

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"/o\"><div>Text<a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
